description: Which material a code names: a UNS number, EN number or name, DIN, JIS, AISI or SAE number, ASTM or AMS specification, or trade name (for example S31600, 1.4401, SUS316, A240). Case, spaces and hyphens do not matter, and a short code also lists the codes that start with it. Each row gives the system, the code, a note (product form or a caveat) and whether the match is exact. A specification such as ASTM A240 covers many grades and returns every material that cites it. A note of "nearest equivalent" means the source itself hedges: do not treat the two as the same grade.

code.description: A designation or trade name, for example S31600, 1.4401, SUS316 or A240

name: resolve_designation
title: Resolve a designation
